  pilot path. This is the required_wiring half of the same class, still open.
- [2026-08-29] specifier: checked before minting - no paused, active…
Approval context: Two things worth your eye before this is built. (1) Severity is high on the grounds that a dark safety gate is worse than a noisy one - say so if you read a pilot-path-only gap as medium. (2) expedite_lib.bb carries a stated machinery-independence rule (no require of handoff_lib.bb / mono_router_li…
